fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant invested Rs. 3,50,000 in a scheme promising fixed monthly returns, but payouts stopped after two months. The matter was brought to Karur East PS on 2025-09-04, while the incident was placed on 2025-09-02 around 17:40 hrs. The complainant, Lavanya Ammal, provided the contact number 9000000175. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Nithin Murugan, using the number 9000000374. The complaint refers to Harish Murugan, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000180. Tamilarasan Selvam (9000000305) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100003. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00142, as the mobile number 9000000374 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly persuaded to deposit funds with a promise of high returns.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, associate, suspect, mobile number, receiving account, digital document, shopping complex
